source:
@@U00738@@
But the lords and ladies of Court started itching, The Queen and her Ladies-in- Waiting were bitching; But nobody dared give those Fine fleas a smack. Let them come biting us, We'll give them a crack.

@@U00740@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00741@@
Let them come biting us, We'll give them a crack.

@@U00743@@
Bravo! Bravo! Well done!

@@U00745@@
That should be the fate of every flea!

@@U00747@@
You get them between your finger and thumb and nip them nicely!

@@U00749@@
Long live freedom! Long live wine!

@@U00751@@
I'd gladly drink a glass to freedom if your wines weren't quite so—awful.

@@U00753@@
Let’s hear no more of that!

@@U00755@@
If the host didn’t mind, I’d treat our worthy guests with a marvelous something from our own fine cellar.
translation:
@@U00738@@
但宫廷里的贵族们和女士们开始心痒痒，女王和她的侍女们开始发牢骚。但没有人敢去打那些细跳蚤。让他们来咬我们，我们就给他们一个机会。

@@U00740@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00741@@
让他们来咬我们，我们就给他们一个机会。

@@U00743@@
太棒了！太棒了！干得好！

@@U00745@@
这应该是每只跳蚤的命运！

@@U00747@@
您可以将它们放在手指和拇指之间并很好地咬住它们！

@@U00749@@
自由万岁！酒万岁！

@@U00751@@
如果你们的酒不是那么糟糕的话，我很乐意为自由喝一杯。

@@U00753@@
我们不要再听到这些了！

@@U00755@@
如果主人不介意的话，我会用我们自己精美地窖里的一些奇妙的东西来款待我们尊贵的客人。
